# RumorLupas

> Online shop selling Oakley sunglasses ("lupas"), based in Portugal and shipping to every country in the European Union.

Every model ships with a micro bag, a cleaning cloth and a case, and all have UV400 protection. Most colours are single units and stock changes often, so a product's own page is the only reliable source for its price and whether it is still available.

Shipping is priced by destination and free on any order of 80 € or more, everywhere:

- Portugal: 4.90 €, 2 to 5 working days
- Spain: 9.90 €, 3 to 7 working days
- The other 25 EU countries: 14.90 €, 5 to 10 working days

The shop does not ship outside the EU. Customers have 14 calendar days from receipt to return an item without giving a reason, provided it comes back unused and in the condition it arrived; returns start by email. Products carry the 3-year legal guarantee of conformity under Portuguese law. Payment is taken in euros through Stripe.

The site is in Portuguese, English and Spanish. Contact: rumorlupas@gmail.com
